# Real Betis vs Getafe, 17 September 2026: research notes

**Note on limits:** Every attempt to open a full page was refused by the proxy, so everything below comes from search-result summaries. Most previews, odds pages and standings tables I found were published after the 2026-09-11 cutoff. I have left all of that out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The official source is LaLiga's match record, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. I could not open any of these pages.
- The venue is listed inconsistently: FotMob says Benito Villamarín, while ticket sellers say Estadio de La Cartuja. [Gametime](https://gametime.co/soccer/real-betis-vs-getafe-cf-tickets/9-17-2026-sevilla-estadio-de-la-cartuja/events/6a4502c396abfe15de9419d4), [GOAL](https://www.goal.com/en-us/tickets-travel/team/real-betis-tickets/A~bltf21ce63ff717778e). Either way, Betis are the home side.

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-11, the match had not been played and nothing settles the question. Betis have a league game before it: Jornada 5 at Villarreal, listed for 13 or 14 September depending on the source. [footballdream](https://www.footballdream.in/blog/la-liga-jornada-5-fixtures-previews-2026-27), [BRYME](https://bryme.onrender.com/sports/la-liga/teams/real-betis/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Early September 2026 (exact date not confirmed): a Jornada 5 preview says Betis beat Real Madrid 1-0 in Jornada 4. [footballdream](https://www.footballdream.in/blog/la-liga-jornada-5-fixtures-previews-2026-27)
- 2026-07-16: Getafe signed full-back Andrés García. [IANS](https://ianslive.in/getafe-strengthens-squad-with-full-back-andres-garcia--20260716204016)
- June 2026: Getafe extended coach José Bordalás's contract to 2028. [FutbolFantasy](https://www.futbolfantasy.com/laliga/noticias/145419-el-getafe-cierra-la-renovacion-de-bordalas-por-dos-temporadas)
- Betis started the season well. I could not reliably confirm full Jornada 1-4 results or the table as of 11 September for either team.

## 4. Base rates
- 2025-12-21: Betis beat Getafe 4-0 at home, with Ruibal scoring twice. [Flashscore](https://www.flashscore.com/news/betis-getafe-laliga-report-2025-12-21/06q5F1Fa)
- March 2026: Getafe beat Betis 2-0 at home. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/match/_/gameId/748413)
- Over recent LaLiga seasons, home teams win roughly 45% of matches in general. That figure is general knowledge, not something I sourced for this report. Getafe under Bordalás are a low-scoring, defensive side that tends to hold down win rates for favourites.
- Getafe were in the lower half of the table in the early weeks of 2026-27 (5 points after 6 matches, per a later Sports Mole preview). I found no Getafe standing dated before the cutoff. [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/getafe/preview/getafe-vs-malaga-prediction-team-news-lineups_605397.html)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices dated on or before 2026-09-11.
- Bookmaker and model pages exist for this match ([Dimers](https://www.dimers.com/la-liga/news/real-betis-vs-getafe-prediction-09-17-2026-ac), [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/laliga-game/getafe-real-betis-score-odds-september-17-2026/292656), [Scores & Stats](https://www.scoresandstats.com/predictions/soccer/la-liga/real-betis-vs-getafe-odds-picks/2026-09-17/)). They all appear to be dated after the cutoff, so I have not used their numbers. Generally, both sides' coverage frames Betis as the home favourite.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 13 or 14 September 2026: Villarreal vs Betis, LaLiga Jornada 5. This adds fatigue risk, because the Getafe match comes only 3 to 4 days later.
- Getafe also play a Jornada 5 match that weekend. I did not find the opponent.
- Watch for team news, including any Betis rotation for European games. Betis's 2026-27 European schedule was not confirmed. Previews flagged injuries for both sides (Aitor Ruibal for Betis; Abqar, Femenía and Juanmi for Getafe), but that comes from post-cutoff sources, so check it against pre-cutoff reporting.
